annotation.title_clean: 杭州市智能网联车辆测试与应用促进条例
annotation.title_en: Hangzhou Regulations on Promoting the Testing and Application of Intelligent Connected Vehicles
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 杭州市人民代表大会常务委员会 (Standing Committee of Hangzhou Municipal People's Congress)
annotation.venue: 杭州市人大常委会公告
annotation.summary_en: Hangzhou municipal regulation, effective 1 May 2024, governing road testing and innovative application of intelligent connected vehicles and unmanned functional vehicles (delivery, inspection, sanitation). It sets tiered testing, safety self-declaration, plates, remote takeover, insurance, accident data recording, cybersecurity and data rules, and suspension penalties.
key_provisions_or_claims: Tiered road testing and application from low to high risk, with takeover-rate thresholds
Safety self-declaration confirmed by the economic and IT authority, then temporary plates or vehicle identification tags
Driverless functional vehicles need remote monitoring, emergency takeover, minimum-risk mode and civil compensation capacity
Accident data (at least 90 seconds prior) must be recorded and given to police within 24 hours
Mandatory insurance, cybersecurity and data localisation rules, with suspension or termination for violations
